tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (14.6:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: stream-dark
tokens.usage: Deep streaming black). Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: content-white
tokens.usage: Soft white). Used as text on `body`, `.nav-link`, `.nav-link:hover, .nav-link:focus`. 14.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: brand-red
tokens.usage: Netflix red). Used as text on `.logo`, `.stat-icon.red`, `.stat-change.negative`. 3.8:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Premium blue). Used as text on `.stat-icon.blue`, `.status-badge.upcoming`. 4.0:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: status-badge-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.status-badge.active`; background on `.status-badge.active`. 9.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: category-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 18.4:1 on `page-bg`.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2.section-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3.content-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `td` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and metadata — as `div.content-meta` on the reference page.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels — as `button.view-all-btn` on the reference page. The reference page leaves this element on the browser default face; set it in the body family.
